name: Pastors
overview: Scripture presents pastors as God-appointed overseers entrusted with the care and feeding of His flock, emphasizing diligence and heartfelt commitment to their spiritual well-being. They are to shepherd the church with knowledge and understanding, exercising authority with accountability, as they will give an account for the souls under their care. The ordination and setting in order of elders reflect the importance of organized leadership within the church, while believers are called to respect and submit to those who watch over their souls. The role of pastors is foundational in equipping the body of Christ for service and maintaining the unity and health of the church.
